description: Move a bottle between unopened, opened, finished, wishlist and tried. Moving into unopened/opened re-checks the free 25-bottle limit. Two steps: the first call only previews and returns confirm_token; show the preview to the user and repeat the call with confirm_token only after they agree.

confirm_token.description: Omit on the first call to get a preview. After the user agrees, call again with identical arguments plus this token.

status.description: unopened/opened count toward the free 25-bottle shelf; finished, wishlist and tried don't

name: set_bottle_status
